name: Dimensional Search
summary: An Object from the deck to Retire; with the die, one from Retire onto your Entity, free.

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Search your deck for an Object with Flux cost 3 or less and put it into your Retire Zone, then shuffle your deck. Then roll a d6: on 3 or more you may assign an Object from your Retire Zone to an Entity you control without paying its Flux cost.
